result.instructions:
Recorder edits screen recordings. Times you send and receive are output seconds (the edited timeline). Typical loop:
project.open → timeline.get + transcript.get → analyze → edit.apply (lands in a draft) → render.frames / render.sheet
to check → fix → draft.submit for the human to review. Pass ifRevision from the latest result. Renders go to a cache
folder; final exports need the user's approval. Key presses are never shared.
To make a demo yourself: record.targets → record.start {window} → drive the app with your own computer-use tool,
calling record.mark {label} when each step begins → record.stop (opens the project) → edit as usual: cut from a
step's settled end to the next step's mark, label steps with text, pace demo, render.lint demo, then draft.submit.

tools.description: Record the screen while your own computer-use tool performs a demo (Recorder never clicks or types). targets lists displays and windows; start needs exactly one of window or display (area needs display) and asks the user once per session; mark labels the current moment (use the returned marker id as an edit anchor later); stop finishes, opens the project and returns what project.open returns. Video only: no mic, camera or system audio. Area coordinates are points relative to the display, top-left origin; width/height resize window targets only. maxDuration defaults to 600 seconds, including pauses. Use step labels before actions, retake: <step> for retries, result for the final state. Use demo accounts; anything on screen is recorded.

tools.name: transcript

tools.description: Transcribe on-device, find mic pauses/fillers, read activity ranges without key characters, or get the shot storyboard (shots: ids stay tied to source moments across edits; times are output seconds).

captions.description: analyze.shots only: add on-device 6–10 word captions per shot (slower; null when unavailable).

response_format.description: analyze.shots only: concise (default) omits reasons only; focus is always kept.

thresholds.description: analyze.shots only: optional overrides of ssim, minStable, cutSsim, motionDiff, payoffDiff, cursorSpeed, energyScale. energyScale and minStable must be > 0; ssim and cutSsim within 0…1.

tools.name: analyze

tools.description: Apply atomic edits using the latest ifRevision; edits land in a draft by default. Numeric times use that revision's output timeline; anchors ({marker:id|label, offset}, {ref:name, offset}, {shot, edge}) resolve after earlier ops in the batch. Declare ref:"name" on an op to anchor later ops on its start. At most one of keepShots/pace/fitDuration per batch (call edit.apply once per intent). Intent fields: keepShots {shots|where{kind,minEnergy}, protect[id|section:N|caption~re], trim}; pace {profile reel|demo|tutorial, maxStatic, beat, speedFill}; fitDuration {target, tolerance, balance energy|even|proportional, minPerSection, drop[section], protect} (protect is per op, repeat it on each intent). undo inside a draft removes your last edit.apply call. Errors carry fix and current.
